sentences.text: Sam dhe Ardi janë te gjyshi në fshat.
sentences.english: Sam and Ardi are at grandfather's in the village.

sentences.text: Është mbrëmje dhe jashtë bie shi.
sentences.english: It is evening and it is raining outside.

sentences.text: Në sobë ka zjarr dhe dhoma është e ngrohtë.
sentences.english: There is a fire in the stove and the room is warm.

sentences.text: Ata ulen pranë sobës dhe pinë çaj.
sentences.english: They sit down by the stove and drink tea.

sentences.text: Ardi ka një pyetje.
sentences.english: Ardi has a question.

sentences.text: — Gjysh, si ishte jeta kur ishe i vogël?
sentences.english: "Grandfather, what was life like when you were small?"

sentences.text: Gjyshi buzëqesh dhe mendon.
sentences.english: Grandfather smiles and thinks.

sentences.text: — Dikur nuk kishim shumë, por ishim të lumtur.
sentences.english: "Back then we did not have much, but we were happy."

sentences.text: — Më trego, gjysh! — thotë Ardi.
sentences.english: "Tell me, grandfather!" says Ardi.

sentences.text: — Mirë. Do të flas për fëmijërinë time. Kujtoj shumë gjëra.
sentences.english: "Good. I will talk about my childhood. I remember many things."

sentences.text: — U linda në këtë fshat, në shtëpinë e vjetër pranë lumit.
sentences.english: "I was born in this village, in the old house by the river."

sentences.text: Ishim pesë fëmijë, tre djem dhe dy vajza.
sentences.english: There were five of us children, three boys and two girls.

sentences.text: Babai punonte në tokë dhe nëna kujdesej për shtëpinë dhe për ne.
sentences.english: Father worked on the land and mother took care of the house and of us.

sentences.text: Nëna kishte sy të mirë dhe fliste pak.
sentences.english: Mother had kind eyes and spoke little.

sentences.text: Kur binte borë, rrinim gjithë ditën pranë sobës, sepse jashtë ishte shumë ftohtë.
sentences.english: When it snowed, we stayed by the stove all day, because it was very cold outside.

sentences.text: Nëna kujdesej për zjarrin dhe gatuante supë.
sentences.english: Mother looked after the fire and cooked soup.

sentences.text: Zjarri ishte i vogël, por dhoma ishte e ngrohtë.
sentences.english: The fire was small, but the room was warm.

sentences.text: Pas darkës babai tregonte histori dhe ne dëgjonim.
sentences.english: After supper father told stories and we listened.

sentences.text: Dikur në fshat kishte shumë fëmijë, prandaj kishim shumë lojëra.
sentences.english: Back then there were many children in the village, so we had many games.

sentences.text: — Në verë shkonim çdo ditë në lumë.
sentences.english: "In summer we went to the river every day."

sentences.text: Ai ishte i gjerë dhe i ftohtë.
sentences.english: It was wide and cold.

sentences.text: Në breg kishte rërë dhe ne luanim me rërën.
sentences.english: On the bank there was sand and we played with the sand.

sentences.text: Rëra ishte e ngrohtë, dhe çdo lojë ishte e bukur.
sentences.english: The sand was warm, and every game was beautiful.

sentences.text: Unë mësova të notoj kur isha pesë vjeç.
sentences.english: I learned to swim when I was five.

sentences.text: Notonim gjithë ditën, dhe unë notoja më mirë se vëllezërit.
sentences.english: We swam all day, and I swam better than my brothers.

sentences.text: Nuk kishim këpucë dhe vraponim në rrugë.
sentences.english: We had no shoes and we ran in the road.

sentences.text: Loja ishte kjo: kush vrapon më shpejt?
sentences.english: The game was this: who runs fastest?

sentences.text: Unë vrapoja më shpejt se të gjithë.
sentences.english: I ran faster than everyone.

sentences.text: Mbanim pesë dhi dhe dy dele.
sentences.english: We kept five goats and two sheep.

sentences.text: Çdo mëngjes shkoja me dhitë në kodër.
sentences.english: Every morning I went with the goats to the hill.

sentences.text: Dhitë më njihnin shumë mirë.
sentences.english: The goats knew me very well.

sentences.text: — Një ditë u ngjita në çatinë e shtëpisë.
sentences.english: "One day I climbed up onto the roof of the house."

sentences.text: Me sytë e mi shihja gjithë fshatin, lumin dhe kodrat.
sentences.english: With my own eyes I saw the whole village, the river and the hills.

sentences.text: Nëna më pa dhe më tha: — Zbrit!
sentences.english: Mother saw me and said to me: "Come down!"

sentences.text: Atë ditë mësova një gjë: çatia nuk është për fëmijë.
sentences.english: That day I learned one thing: the roof is not for children.

sentences.text: Por unë ngjitesha çdo ditë.
sentences.english: But I climbed up every day.

sentences.text: Një herë babai erdhi nga puna dhe më pa në çati.
sentences.english: Once father came back from work and saw me on the roof.

sentences.text: Ai nuk tha asgjë, por buzëqeshi.
sentences.english: He said nothing, but he smiled.

sentences.text: — Një herë në vit shkonim te liqeni.
sentences.english: "Once a year we went to the lake."

sentences.text: Liqeni ishte larg, kështu ngjiteshim në kodër gjithë ditën.
sentences.english: The lake was far, so we climbed the hill all day.

sentences.text: Aty nëna hapte çantën dhe na jepte bukë, djathë dhe mollë.
sentences.english: There mother opened the bag and gave us bread, cheese and apples.

sentences.text: Uleshim në breg dhe hanim bashkë.
sentences.english: We sat on the bank and ate together.

sentences.text: Liqeni ishte shumë i madh.
sentences.english: The lake was very big.

sentences.text: Aty në breg kishte shumë zogj.
sentences.english: There on the shore there were many birds.

sentences.text: Ky është një kujtim shumë i bukur.
sentences.english: This is a very beautiful memory.

sentences.text: — Babai punonte larg, në qytet.
sentences.english: "Father worked far away, in the town."

sentences.text: Posta vinte një herë në javë.
sentences.english: The post came once a week.

sentences.text: Nëna priste postën pranë derës.
sentences.english: Mother waited for the post by the door.

sentences.text: Një ditë erdhi një zarf.
sentences.english: One day an envelope came.

sentences.text: Brenda kishte një kartolinë dhe një shënim të vogël.
sentences.english: Inside there was a postcard and a small note.

sentences.text: Babai shkruante: — Shpresoj që jeni mirë.
sentences.english: Father wrote: "I hope you are well."

sentences.text: Nëna lexoi dhe i shkroi një përgjigje.
sentences.english: Mother read it and wrote him an answer.

sentences.text: Ajo i përgjigjej çdo herë.
sentences.english: She answered him every time.

sentences.text: Kartolinën e ruaj edhe sot.
sentences.english: I keep the postcard even today.

sentences.text: — A kishit shkollë në fshat? — pyet Sam.
sentences.english: "Did you have a school in the village?" asks Sam.

sentences.text: — Kishim një shkollë të vogël. Mësuesi vinte nga qyteti dhe na mësonte të lexojmë.
sentences.english: "We had a small school. The teacher came from the town and taught us to read."

sentences.text: — Kisha një ëndërr: të bëhesha mësues.
sentences.english: "I had a dream: to become a teacher."

sentences.text: Por nuk kishim mundësi të paguanim shkollën.
sentences.english: But we could not afford to pay for school.

sentences.text: Kisha një dëshirë të madhe të mësoj, prandaj lexoja çdo libër.
sentences.english: I had a great wish to learn, so I read every book.

sentences.text: — Të dielën nuk punonim.
sentences.english: "On Sunday we did not work."

sentences.text: Ndërronim këmishën dhe shkonim në kishë.
sentences.english: We changed our shirts and went to church.

sentences.text: Kisha ishte e vogël.
sentences.english: The church was small.

sentences.text: Kori këndonte dhe të gjithë dëgjonin.
sentences.english: The choir sang and everyone listened.

sentences.text: Pas shërbimit pastori jepte një bekim.
sentences.english: After the service the pastor gave a blessing.

sentences.text: Dëshmoj se ato të diela ishin të mira.
sentences.english: I can testify that those Sundays were good.

sentences.text: — Fqinjët vinin shpesh dhe rrinim bashkë.
sentences.english: "The neighbours came often and we sat together."

sentences.text: Një zonjë e vjetër, shoqja e nënës, sillte djathë.
sentences.english: An old lady, mother's friend, used to bring cheese.

sentences.text: Një ditë erdhi një mysafir nga qyteti.
sentences.english: One day a guest came from the town.

sentences.text: Ai ishte një mik i babait.
sentences.english: He was a friend of father's.

sentences.text: Ishte zakon që vizitori të rrinte te ne një natë.
sentences.english: It was the custom that the visitor stayed with us for a night.

sentences.text: Mysafiri më solli një dhuratë: një çokollatë.
sentences.english: The guest brought me a present: a chocolate.

sentences.text: Në festë nëna piqte një tortë.
sentences.english: On a feast day mother baked a cake.

sentences.text: Ishte një traditë e vjetër.
sentences.english: It was an old tradition.

sentences.text: Akulloren e hëngra shumë më vonë, kur isha i ri, në qytet.
sentences.english: I ate ice cream much later, when I was young, in the town.

sentences.text: — Kur babai vdiq, unë isha i ri.
sentences.english: "When father died, I was young."

sentences.text: Vdekja e tij ishte e rëndë për ne.
sentences.english: His death was hard for us.

sentences.text: Në rini punova në qytet.
sentences.english: In my youth I worked in the town.

sentences.text: Në moshën njëzet vjeç u martova.
sentences.english: At the age of twenty I got married.

sentences.text: Pastaj jeta ndërroi, por unë ruaj fëmijërinë time.
sentences.english: Then life changed, but I keep my childhood.

sentences.text: Babai dhe nëna na rritën me shumë dashuri, në atë mënyrë.
sentences.english: Father and mother raised us with much love, in that way.

sentences.text: Gjyshi mbyll sytë.
sentences.english: Grandfather closes his eyes.

sentences.text: — Faleminderit, gjysh — thotë Sam. — Kjo histori është shumë e bukur.
sentences.english: "Thank you, grandfather," says Sam. "This story is very beautiful."

sentences.text: — Dikur jeta ishte e bukur, por sot jeni ju këtu — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Back then life was beautiful, but today you are here," says grandfather.

sentences.text: — Gjysh, a të pëlqen fshati edhe sot? — pyet Ardi.
sentences.english: "Grandfather, do you like the village even today?" asks Ardi.

sentences.text: — Shumë, sepse këtu jam në shtëpi — thotë gjyshi.
sentences.english: "Very much, because here I am at home," says grandfather.

sentences.text: Ardi ulet pranë tij dhe buzëqesh.
sentences.english: Ardi sits down next to him and smiles.
